English stop words used by the semantic search

Source: R/text.R
jtb_stopwords.Rd

A small, general-purpose list. Pass your own vector to jtb_search_semantic(stopwords = ...), or character() to keep every word.

Usage

jtb_stopwords()

Value

A character vector of lower-case stop words.

Examples

head(jtb_stopwords(), 10)
#>  [1] "a"     "about" "above" "after" "again" "all"   "also"  "am"    "an"   
#> [10] "and"  
length(jtb_stopwords())
#> [1] 115
